story_brief: Recut one continuous source into a chronological action trailer. Begin on the tower-scale mechanical threat, move forward into the workshop team's hands and device, reveal the operator only long enough to read the preparation, bridge into the machine activating, and drive into the strongest battle through frame 388. At frame 388, end every photographed action and cut to a purpose-built TEARS OF STEEL title card for the full musical decay. The title is the resolution: do not substitute a death animation, fallen-robot hold, freeze frame, additional source shot, or continued battle. The three reviewed music cuts remain exact beat anchors; frame 203 is an intentionally off-beat story cut. Every media source range must advance in source time and every hard cut must have clean incoming handles.
